# Lab 22.2: Measure BI Engine Acceleration

## What We Are Going to Do
Check which queries BI Engine accelerated, read the reasons when it did not, and monitor the reservation.

## Steps

1. **[SQL] Check recent jobs.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • SQL
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">SELECT
  job_id,
  bi_engine_statistics.bi_engine_mode AS mode,
  bi_engine_statistics.acceleration_mode AS accel,
  ARRAY(SELECT r.message FROM UNNEST(bi_engine_statistics.bi_engine_reasons) r) AS reasons,
  LEFT(query, 60) AS q
FROM `region-us`.INFORMATION_SCHEMA.JOBS_BY_USER
WHERE creation_time &gt; TIMESTAMP_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 1 HOUR)
ORDER BY creation_time DESC LIMIT 10;</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


   `FULL` means fully accelerated; `PARTIAL` or `DISABLED` comes with a reason.

2. **[SQL] Make a query that is not accelerated.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • SQL
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">SELECT * FROM `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.orders` LIMIT 10;</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


   Check step 1 again. The reason says the table is not a preferred table.

3. **[SQL] Read the capacity views.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • SQL
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">SELECT * FROM `region-us`.INFORMATION_SCHEMA.BI_CAPACITIES;
SELECT * FROM `region-us`.INFORMATION_SCHEMA.BI_CAPACITY_CHANGES ORDER BY change_timestamp DESC;</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


4. **[Console] Monitor.** In **Monitoring → Metrics explorer**, look at **BigQuery BI Engine → Reservation used bytes** to see whether 1 GiB is enough.

5. **[CLI] Count accelerated jobs from bq.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">bq query --use_legacy_sql=false \
'SELECT bi_engine_statistics.bi_engine_mode AS mode, COUNT(*) AS jobs FROM `region-us`.INFORMATION_SCHEMA.JOBS_BY_USER
 WHERE creation_time &gt; TIMESTAMP_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 1 DAY) GROUP BY mode'</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


## Expected Result

| Thing | Reality |
|---|---|
| Mode | FULL, PARTIAL or DISABLED |
| Reasons | Why a query was not accelerated |
| Views | BI_CAPACITIES and BI_CAPACITY_CHANGES |
| Sizing | Watch memory used vs reserved |
